capabilities: Convert pasted chat replies on paste
Format selection or whole note via ribbon button
Wrap bare TeX expressions in $ delimiters
Preview conversion in standalone web app
disambiguation: Not a general LaTeX editor or renderer; it only converts pasted or selected chat text into Obsidian Markdown.
extras: Conversion runs locally; remote images are fetched from their host and exported notes keep the image URL. Also ships a standalone web app and downloadable offline HTML preview. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Copying ChatGPT explanations into Obsidian loses equation delimiters, flattens symbol tables, and mangles TeX in subscripts and norms.

relations.evidence: Formula to Note and Math Paste Bridge both recover TeX from rich text with LaTeX annotations.
Transfer LaTeX from GPT inspired the location of the Σ button.

summary: Paste handler and ribbon command that convert ChatGPT replies into Obsidian notes with LaTeX delimiters, symbol tables, and code blocks intact.
